goal.en: By the end, you'll know what PAIVM & PPIVM Spinal Assessment / Mobilization is, when it's safe and useful, how to apply it step by step — and how to prove it worked. (3 checks along the way.)

text.en: PPIVMs (Passive Physiological Intervertebral Movements) and PAIVMs (Passive Accessory Intervertebral Movements) are hands-on tests of how each spinal segment moves and whether it hurts. They help you decide where to treat. They are also used for mobilization.
text.ur: PAIVM aur PPIVM spinal examination ka hissa hain. Treatment ka faisla symptoms ke response par hona chahiye, sirf segmental diagnosis assume karke nahi.

simpler.en: Hands-on spinal examination: PPIVMs test movement between vertebrae through natural bends; PAIVMs test small glides between them.
simpler.ur: PAIVM aur PPIVM spinal assessment ke tareeqay hain: PAIVM mein accessory pressure aur PPIVM mein spine ki physiological movement assess ki jati hai.

text.en: Walking along a row of doors and pushing each one lightly: you note which one sticks, which one swings too freely and which one makes a squeaky sound that matches the patient's complaint.
text.ur: Darwazon ki ek line ke saath chalte hue har darwaze ko halka sa dhakelna: aap note karte hain kaun sa atakta hai, kaun sa zarurat se zyada aasaani se khulta hai, aur kaun si 'cheekh' patient ki shikayat se milti hai.

text.en:
Three ideas carry this whole technique:
**1.** Pain response is more reliable than judging stiffness by feel. Ask what the patient feels at every level.
**2.** Always compare neighboring levels and think in three parts: how much it moves, how it feels and what it provokes.
**3.** A stiff segment does not prove it is the cause. Link what you find to the patient's comparable sign.
text.ur: PAIVM mein central ya unilateral posterior-anterior jaisi controlled accessory force di jati hai; PPIVM mein spinal segments ke darmiyan passive physiological movement assess hoti hai. Segmental motion palpation ki stand-alone reliability aur diagnostic validity limited hai. Is liye history, neurological exam, active movement aur patient's comparable sign ke sath findings interpret karein. Behtar clinical use hypothesis test karna hai: kya controlled input symptoms ya movement ko reproduce, reduce ya meaningful taur par change karta hai?

text.en:
So when does **PAIVM & PPIVM Spinal Assessment / Mobilization** make sense?
• Back or neck pain where you want to find the most relevant segment.
• Before choosing mobilization level and direction.
• To retest after treatment.
text.ur: Mechanical spinal pain jahan comparable sign reproduce ho; painful ya restricted spinal movement jahan segmental treatment trial madadgar ho sakta ho; cervical, thoracic ya lumbar examination ka adjunct.

text.en:
And just as important — when you should NOT use it, or should stop:
• Suspected fracture, instability or serious pathology (use medical assessment first).
• Severe pain or irritability where testing would cause a flare.
• Any neurological deficit that is progressing.
text.ur:
High irritability, osteoporosis ya fracture risk, recent trauma ya surgery, neurological symptoms, aur upper cervical presentations jahan specific vascular aur ligament screening zaroori ho.
Suspected fracture ya instability, acute myelopathy ya progressive neurological deficit, region mein active infection ya malignancy, suspected cervical arterial pathology, ya koi presentation jise urgent medical assessment chahiye.
Spinal assessment se pehle red flags, trauma, neurological changes aur relevant contraindications screen karein. Forceful testing, pain provoke karke repeat karna, ya uncertain segmental finding ko definitive lesion kehna avoid karein.

title.en: How to do it — 6 steps, each with its reason
title.ur: Kaise karein — 6 qadam, har ek ki wajah ke saath

steps.title: Screen and ask about the pain
steps.detail: Know the pain area and the comparable sign before testing.

steps.title: Position
steps.detail: Example: prone with the spine in a neutral resting position for lumbar PAIVMs.

steps.title: Locate the segments
steps.detail: Palpate the spinous processes and identify levels accurately.

steps.title: Test central PA at each level
steps.detail: Press gently and rhythmically. Note stiffness, spring and pain at each level.

steps.title: Compare unilateral PA, then PPIVM
steps.detail: Repeat to the left and right and in bending directions if needed.

steps.title: Record and link
steps.detail: Record 'hypo/normal/hyper' and the pain response, then check whether treating that level improves the comparable sign.

beats.ur:
1. Segmental testing se pehle active movement, neurological status aur comparable sign note karein.
2. Patient ko relaxed position mein rakhein aur target level tak baghair unnecessary force ke pohanchein.
3. PAIVM ke liye graded central ya unilateral accessory pressure dein aur pain, resistance aur symptom distribution monitor karein.
4. PPIVM ke liye relevant physiological movement guide karte hue relative segmental motion palpate karein.
5. Sirf palpation par segment ko 'stuck' ya 'out of place' label na karein.
6. Treatment trial ke baad original comparable sign foran dobara check karein; technique tabhi retain karein jab useful change aaye.

text.en: How much? Assessment pressure is gentle and brief: a few oscillations per level. When used as treatment, follow the Maitland grading and dose guidance.
text.ur: Assessment mein symptom response aur movement behavior judge karne ke liye minimum force use karein. Therapeutic trial mein irritability ke mutabiq grade aur amplitude rakh kar 30–60 seconds ke 2–4 sets test kiye ja sakte hain. Dose palpated stiffness ke bajaye response-guided honi chahiye.

beats.patient: Priya, 34, low back pain on bending forward after gardening.
beats.assessment: Central PA at L4 reproduces her pain and feels stiffer than L3 and L5. Forward bending is limited by pain.
beats.treatment: A Grade III central PA at L4 for 30 seconds, three sets, in prone.
beats.reassess: Forward bending improves by several centimeters with less pain, which confirms L4 is relevant. If bending had not changed, you would search another level or direction.
beats.ur:
Ek misal se poora clinical flow dekhein:
Farz karein back pain ke sath ek comparable movement limited hai. Clinician screening ke baad gentle segmental input se pehle aur baad us movement ko compare karta hai. Palpation ka ehsaas akela diagnosis nahi banta. Yeh illustrative example hai.

text.en:
The mistakes I see most often:
• Trusting the feel of stiffness alone without linking to pain or function.
• Testing at the wrong level through poor palpation.
• Using too much force in an irritable spine.
text.ur:

• Testing at the wrong level through poor palpation.
• Using too much force in an irritable spine.

text.en: One line to carry into the clinic: **Test each level, ask about pain, and prove relevance by retesting.**
text.ur: PAIVM/PPIVM findings clinical reasoning ka sirf ek hissa hain, apne aap mein diagnosis nahi. Examiner ko stiff mehsoos hone wala segment lazmi nahi ke pain ka source ho. Minimum effective manual input use karke gain ko active movement mein transfer karein.
